description: Master told Harper to treat the Sean Antonello episode as Season 2 Episode 1 without verifying the season break. Janine's SharePoint doc was filed as 'Season 1_Episode 9_Topics and Questions.docx'. The Obsidian episode map shows Season 1 ran episodes 1-8, but that was because Episode 9 had not yet been added — it is still Season 1. Files were generated with incorrect episode label 'S2E1'.
correction: Should have read the Obsidian episode map and Janine's doc naming before asserting a season number. The correct label is Season 1, Episode 9.
systemic_fix: Workflow step-01 identifies episode from the Obsidian map and Janine's doc naming — Master should not override or pre-assert episode/season numbering in the spawn payload. Pass raw context only; let Harper determine the episode number.
